title: Japan's JERA in talks with Anthropic, Meta on AI data centers
html:
Japan's largest power producer, JERA, is in talks with Anthropic, Meta, Amazon, Microsoft, and Google to develop data centers near its power plants in the Tokyo area, JERA global CEO and chair Yukio Kani told Nikkei in a recent interview.
